AboutPage.metaDescription: Vault: streetwear and classic wear, curated drops, quality, and service — launched 2025.
AboutPage.hook: An introduction is long overdue — we’re glad you’re here.
AboutPage.p1: We take pride in hand-picking standout streetwear and classic wear: pieces with real character that earn a place in your rotation. Our mission is to bring you culture-driven must-haves and timeless silhouettes — fabrics and details that work for everyday street style and sharper, more refined moments.
AboutPage.p2: Vault opened in 2025 with streetwear at the heart of our curation, plus classic pieces you can dress up or down. Fewer filler drops, more items you’ll actually want to wear — from daytime fits to nights out, we want you to move with confidence every time you get dressed.
AboutPage.p3: Our online store serves Lebanon and beyond — quality you can feel, responsive customer service, and straightforward pricing. Shopping stays simple so you can focus on looking your best.
AboutPage.ctaTitle: So what are you waiting for?

SupportReturns.metaDescription: How to return or exchange Vault orders in Lebanon.
SupportReturns.p1: We want you to be happy with your purchase. Under Lebanese consumer protection rules and our Terms of Service, you may have the right to cancel certain distance sales within 10 days of receiving your order, when items are unused and in their original packaging with tags where applicable.
SupportReturns.p3: To start a return, exchange, or cancellation, reach us with your order number so we can confirm eligibility and give you the next steps (including where to send goods if a return is approved).
SupportReturns.p4After: page, email, or WhatsApp — see details there.

SupportShipping.metaDescription: How Vault ships orders in Lebanon and Cash on Delivery.
SupportShipping.p1: We deliver within Lebanon. Timeframes or fees shown at checkout are estimates only; actual delivery can vary with location, carrier capacity, weather, or other factors outside our control.
SupportShipping.p2: Our standard payment method is Cash on Delivery (COD): please have the full order amount ready when your package arrives, as set out in our Terms.
SupportShipping.p3: If you need to change delivery details after ordering, contact us as soon as possible. We may verify your phone number before dispatch to reduce failed deliveries.

SupportContact.metaDescription: Reach Vault by email, WhatsApp, or Instagram.
SupportContact.intro: For orders, returns, sizing, or general questions, reach us using any of the options below.
SupportContact.responseNote: We aim to reply within a reasonable time during business hours. For order issues, include your order number if you have one.
